summary: Iteration 41 verified: (A) event_lifecycle.run_tick automation module + POST /api/admin/events/lifecycle/tick admin endpoint, and (B) mandatory start_date/end_date at create-time with editable PATCH. Wrote 25-test pytest suite (test_iter41_lifecycle.py) covering create/patch date rules, admin-tick RBAC, all 4 status transitions, and all 6 reminder stages including cooldown. 24 pass, 1 skipped (HR seed unavailable — clean-slate mode). Also fixed 4 pre-iter41 test files whose event-create payloads were missing dates. Full targeted regression: 64 passed, 1 skipped. Frontend spot-check on preview URL: EventStatusBadge renders correctly with proper color, border, bg and data-testid.

minor.issue: Not related to iter41: routes/events.py auto-completes stale events in list_events + get_event based on end_date < today; this can conflict with the lifecycle scheduler's cancelled/completed distinction. When an event has 0 fixtures but its end_date is past, get_event now marks it 'completed' while run_tick would (correctly) leave it as-is because no fixtures exist. Behavior is inconsistent but non-blocking — the lifecycle module intentionally skips the completed_status when 0 fixtures + 0 started, but the on-read auto-complete overrides. Consider making the on-read helper defer to lifecycle rules (cancelled if 0 started + fixtures exist).

action_items: OPTIONAL — align routes/events.py list_events()/get_event() auto-complete helper with the new lifecycle rules so it doesn't flip an event to 'completed' when there are 0 fixtures (should let the tick module cancel it instead).
OPTIONAL — extract a shared /_status_from_dates helper if the two logics are kept consistent.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/event_lifecycle.py — clean, well-commented, single-file module. _derive_status is pure (no I/O), which made unit-testing status transitions trivial. Fixture query only filters by is_local_match!=True + date/status windows — good for DB efficiency.

routes/event_lifecycle.py:213 — the mongo $or includes {status: {$ne: completed}, start_date: {$ne: None}} which will match almost every non-completed event; this is fine at daily cadence but scale may need pagination if events grow past 10k. Currently 120 events — fine.

routes/event_lifecycle.py:_send_reminder — persists timestamp AFTER the send call, so if send_email raises the reminder ts is never written (retry-safe). Uses dotted-path $set for last_reminder_sent.{stage} — correct mongodb pattern.

routes/events.py:257-277 — new required-date guard is correctly placed BEFORE sport enrichment so 400s short-circuit early. Both start_date and end_date are .strip()'d before storage which prevents pure-whitespace bypass.

routes/events.py:704-734 — PATCH guards use `if key in body` to distinguish 'not sent' from 'explicit blank'. `effective_start = body.get(k, existing.get(k))` correctly falls back to existing DB value for order check. Sensitive fields protected via body.pop() loop.

routes/events.py:169-177 — legacy list_events auto-complete helper (pre-iter41) sets status='completed' when end_date < today, regardless of fixture activity. This conflicts with the new Rule C (cancelled if 0 started). Non-blocking, but flagged in action_items — the two code paths should agree.
server.py:5099-5104 — event_lifecycle registered via SimpleNamespace deps (require_platform_admin only). Same pattern as sitemap/CS/players_corp_email — consistent.

server.py:5148-5149 — start_event_lifecycle_scheduler wired inside on_startup. Verified no import cycle; import is inside the function to avoid triggering the scheduler on module import (e.g., during unit tests that import server.py directly).

frontend/EventStatusBadge.jsx — single-file, ~30 LoC, no external deps. TONE map has 5 states matching backend literals. testid pattern data-testid=event-status-{status} is exactly what E1 promised. Verified live on /events/{id} page — 'upcoming' badge renders yellow (rgb(250,204,21)) with correct border+bg.
frontend/Admin.jsx:74-79 — client guard toast.error('Start date and end date are required.') matches the backend error exactly, so user sees consistent messaging.
components/admin/EventsTab.jsx:41-42 — mirrors Admin.jsx guards + adds end_date < start_date pre-check, avoiding a wasted API round-trip.
TEST — all 4 lifecycle status rules verified end-to-end: cancelled (past-end + fixtures + 0 started), completed (past-end + ≥1 live), ongoing (today in-range), upcoming (future).
TEST — all 6 reminder stages verified: no_teams, no_fixtures (with cooldown), starts_tomorrow, start_today, no_activity_8h, publish_results — each writes last_reminder_sent.{stage} timestamp.
TEST — RBAC verified: platform_admin can POST /admin/events/lifecycle/tick (200), player/organiser/anonymous return 401/403.
